name: Peregrine Mark
tagline: The last word on what's real.
positioning: Museum-grade authentication for luxury goods entering resale — so every Birkin, Rolex, and pair of Jordans carries proof, not a seller's promise.

hero.sub: Before you list that watch, that bag, those grails — let a Peregrine expert render a verdict backed by forensic imaging and a tamper-proof certificate the whole market trusts.

features.title: Verdict in 12 hours
features.description: Upload date-code shots, hardware, and stitching. A senior authenticator returns a signed real-or-replica verdict — usually before the next morning.

features.title: The Peregrine Certificate
features.description: Every genuine item earns a numbered digital certificate with forensic imagery, expert notes, and a QR passport buyers can verify in one tap.

features.title: NFC provenance seal
features.description: An optional tamper-evident seal links the physical piece to its record for life. Cut it, and the certificate flags — no more swapped goods after the sale.

features.title: Category depth
features.description: Specialists for handbags, Swiss watches, fine jewelry, and sneakers — not one generalist guessing across every house from Hermès to Patek.

features.title: Resale value signal
features.description: See a live comparable-sales range beside your verdict, so you price with the market instead of against it.

features.title: Marketplace passport
features.description: Attach your certificate to any listing on Vestiaire, Grailed, or eBay. Verified sellers close faster and hold their margin.

testimonials.quote: I've flipped luxury for nine years and disputes were my tax. Since I attach a Peregrine Certificate to every listing, buyers stop haggling on authenticity and start paying my ask.
testimonials.name: Dominique Farrell

testimonials.quote: A client tried to return a 'fake' Cartier that our verdict proved was genuine and unaltered — the NFC seal was intact. Peregrine turned a chargeback into a closed case in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Anselm Whitcombe

testimonials.quote: I collect grail sneakers, not receipts. Having every pair authenticated and passported means when I finally sell, provenance is already done. It's the only vault I trust.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair
